questionText: The 'Birhor' tribe of the Chotanagpur plateau (Jharkhand), whose name literally translates to 'Men of the Forest', traditionally specialized in:

options.text: Small game hunting, bird trapping, and manufacturing coarse bark ropes for barter
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Birhor: Nomadic Rope-Makers and Monkey Hunters.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Socio-Cultural Anthropology (Birhor: Nomadic Rope-Makers and Monkey Hunters):
Small game hunting, bird trapping, and manufacturing coarse bark ropes for barter

Detailed Context:
The Birhor are a semi-nomadic hunter-gatherer tribe traditionally inhabiting the forests of the Chotanagpur plateau in Jharkhand. Their traditional economy relied on hunting small forest game, trapping birds, and manufacturing coarse bark ropes (chop rope) from wild creepers to barter for food grains in local village markets. Hence Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText:

List I:
(A) Lineage
(B) Clan (Sib)
(C) Phratry
(D) Moiety

List II:
(I) Unilineal descent group whose members claim descent from a mythical or totemic ancestor without being able to trace exact genealogical links
(II) Unilineal descent group whose members can demonstrate precise genealogical links to a known historical common ancestor
(III) A grouping or confederation of two or more clans sharing a common ritual identity
(IV) The dual division of an entire society into two exogamous complementary descent halves

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
